user.title: Security Assistant — Setup
user.description: Enter the NetFlow listener address and your internal network ranges. All advanced settings (scanner, DNS proxy, enrichment, baseline, etc.) can be configured from the Security Assistant panel after setup.

privacy.title: Privacy and active features
privacy.description:
Both features are off by default.

**Active scanner**: periodically pings and port-scans hosts on your internal networks and reads service banners. It finds vulnerable services but can trigger other intrusion detection and upset fragile IoT devices. Home Assistant's own addresses are never scanned.

**IP geolocation**: sends every public IP address your devices contact to the third-party service ipwho.is to show its country and network owner.

You can change both later in the integration options or the Security Assistant settings.

init.title: Security Assistant — Listener Settings
init.description: Update the NetFlow listener address and internal networks. All advanced settings are available from the Security Assistant panel → Settings.

error.invalid_networks: Enter one or more valid CIDR ranges separated by commas

trigger_scan.name: Trigger active host scan
trigger_scan.description: Immediately run a full active network scan (ping + port scan) for all known and observed IPs, without waiting for the next scheduled interval.

blacklist_refresh.name: Force refresh threat intel blocklists
blacklist_refresh.description: Immediately clear all loaded threat-intel entries and re-download every configured blocklist URL.

nvd_refresh.name: Refresh NVD vulnerability database
nvd_refresh.description: Flush the local NVD CVE cache and re-fetch fresh vulnerability data from the National Vulnerability Database.

start_baseline_training.name: Start baseline training
start_baseline_training.description: Start baseline training mode and learn a normal activity profile for the configured training duration.

stop_baseline_training.name: Stop baseline training
stop_baseline_training.description: Stop baseline training mode immediately and promote the learned state to the active baseline if any hosts were observed.

clear_baseline.name: Clear baseline
clear_baseline.description: Remove the current baseline state and training progress from persistent storage.

retrain_baseline.name: Retrain baseline
retrain_baseline.description: Clear the current baseline state and immediately restart training mode.

dns_proxy_not_running.title: DNS proxy is not running
dns_proxy_not_running.description: The DNS proxy could not listen on {host}:{port}. Another service (for example AdGuard, Pi-hole or systemd-resolved) probably uses that port. Change the DNS proxy port or bind address in the Security Assistant settings, or stop the other service.

suricata_not_running.title: Suricata listener is not running
suricata_not_running.description: The Suricata alert listener could not listen on {host}:{port}. Change the listener port in the Security Assistant settings or free the port.

suricata_unauthenticated.title: Suricata listener accepts alerts from anyone
suricata_unauthenticated.description: Any device that can reach {host}:{port} can submit Suricata alerts, which can trigger your automations. Set a listener auth token and/or allowed pusher sources in the Security Assistant settings, and start suricata_pusher.py with the same token.

netflow_open_listener.title: NetFlow listener accepts flows from any sender
netflow_open_listener.description: Any device that can reach {host}:{port} can send fake flows, creating false findings and using your enrichment quota. Set 'Allowed NetFlow Exporters' to your router's address in the Security Assistant settings.

blocklist_empty.title: Threat-intel blocklists are empty
blocklist_empty.description: None of the configured blocklist URLs returned any entries, so malicious domains and IPs are not being detected or blocked. Check the URLs in the Security Assistant settings and Home Assistant's internet access.
